issue_title: Performance persistently below 85 threshold: /projects/screenshot-to-primevue (81, LCP 4.3 s)
issue_body:
# Performance below threshold — /projects/screenshot-to-primevue (persistent, 6+ cycles)

Audited: **2026-10-05T17:08:25.456Z**

## Affected page

| Page | Perf | LCP | TBT |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/projects/screenshot-to-primevue` | 81 (was 79) | 4320 ms | 73 ms |

> All other pages are at or above threshold: `/` (92), `/about` (91), `/projects` (90), `/projects/note-structurer` (85, recovered this cycle).

## Why this matters
`/projects/screenshot-to-primevue` has been below the 85 performance threshold for **at least 6 consecutive audit cycles**. LCP has improved slightly from ~4.6 s to ~4.3 s but remains persistently elevated. TBT continues to improve, confirming LCP is the sole remaining bottleneck. This is a structural issue, not measurement noise.

## Recommended fixes
1. **Convert hero/LCP images to WebP or AVIF** with correct `srcset` / `sizes` to reduce initial payload.
2. **Add `fetchpriority="high"`** to the LCP image element so the browser prioritises it earlier in the load waterfall.
3. **Preconnect or preload** critical third-party origins (fonts, CDN assets) that may be adding latency before LCP.
4. **Code-split** any non-critical JS bundles on this page to reduce time-to-interactive and indirectly help LCP.

## Visual status
All pages are visually intact on desktop and mobile — no layout breakage, overflow, missing sections, or contrast issues detected.
